sexy-fruits.title: 1. Rigid Screen (Exact Placement)
sexy-fruits.description: Replicates a perfect 25-symbol screen manually without triggering any features.

sexy-fruits.title: 2. Loose Symbols (Count-based Placement)
sexy-fruits.description: Ensures exactly 6 H1_Watermelon symbols are placed randomly; engine fills the remaining 19 normally.

sexy-fruits.title: 3. H1 Minimum Cluster (5 Symbols)
sexy-fruits.description: Forces an H1 cluster of exactly 5 symbols in the first column.

sexy-fruits.title: 4. Tumble Win (2 Forced Cascades)
sexy-fruits.description: Forces 2 complete winning cycles (The initial screen plus one forced refill win).

sexy-fruits.title: 5. Multiplier Growth (growCount)
sexy-fruits.description: Forces the cluster in the first cascade to grow exactly twice, resulting in a 3x Multiplier.

sexy-fruits.title: 6. Golden Symbol Transformation
sexy-fruits.description: Verifies that a Golden H1 transforms into a Wild at its exact position upon popping.

sexy-fruits.title: 7. Wild Sharing Showcase (Multi Clusters)
sexy-fruits.description: Uses the smart generator to build two clusters around a formed Wild. Requires Golden in Round 1 and forcing Round 2 via cascadeCount.

sexy-fruits.title: 8. Total Free Spins (15 Spins)
sexy-fruits.description: Forces the total number of Free Spins to be 15 (Initial 10 + 1 Retrigger).

sexy-fruits.title: 9. Per-Spin Free Spin Config
sexy-fruits.description: Overrides individual free spin outcomes: Spin 0 gets 3x multiplier, Spin 1 gets 2 cascades.

sexy-fruits.title: 10. No Win
sexy-fruits.description: Target: 0 coins. Strategy: cascadeCount: 0 , backend randomly generates screens with no cluster forming at all.

sexy-fruits.title: 11. Big Win (20x - 50x)
sexy-fruits.description: BetBase: 20 coins. Target: 400 - 1,000 coins. Strategy: We drop 14 H1_Watermelon symbols. The paytable for exactly 14 H1s is 600 coins. With cascadeCount: 1 and no extra growths, the multiplier stays at 1x. Total payout is exactly 600 coins (30x bet).

sexy-fruits.title: 12. Mega Win (50x - 100x)
sexy-fruits.description: BetBase: 20 coins. Target: 1,000 - 2,000 coins. Strategy: We increase the cluster to 15 H1_Watermelon symbols. The paytable caps out at 15+ symbols, paying exactly 1,200 coins. Multiplier remains 1x, giving us exactly 1,200 coins (60x bet).

sexy-fruits.title: 13. Super Win (100x - 150x)
sexy-fruits.description: BetBase: 20 coins. Target: 2,000 - 3,000 coins. Strategy: We use a 15+ H1 cluster (1,200 payout) but force it to grow exactly 1 time during the hold phase (growCount: 1). This bumps the multiplier to 2x. The single pop resolves as 1200 * 2 = 2,400 coins (120x bet).

sexy-fruits.title: 14. Epic Win (150x - 5000x)
sexy-fruits.description: BetBase: 20 coins. Target: 3,000 - 100,000 coins. Strategy: We take the 15+ H1 cluster (1,200 payout) and force it to grow 4 times (growCount: 4). This builds the multiplier up to 5x before the pop. The payout resolves as 1200 * 5 = 6,000 coins (300x bet).

sexy-fruits.title: 15. Max Win (5000x+)
sexy-fruits.description: BetBase: 20 coins. Target: 100,000+ coins (Caps out the game). Strategy: We try to win some H1 and H2 cluster win at BaseSpin initial screen. Then let backend generates 150 cascades, allowing the accumulated win x 200 at final.

magic-g.title: 1. Big Win (20x - 50x)
magic-g.description: Target: 400 - 1,000 coins. Strategy: H2_Princess (12+ cluster) pays exactly 500 coins. Additional two tumbles generate minor wins, bringing the total to ~550 - 800.

magic-g.title: 2. Mega Win (50x - 150x)
magic-g.description: Target: 1,000 - 3,000 coins. Strategy: H1_Aladdin (12+ cluster) pays 1,000 coins + M2 multiplier. Entire tumble multiplied by 2 (~2,100 - 2,500).

magic-g.title: 3. Huge Win (150x - 5000x)
magic-g.description: Target: 3,000 - 100,000 coins. Strategy: H1_Aladdin (12+ cluster) pays 1,000 coins + M25 multiplier. 1,000 * 25 = 25,000 coins base (~1,250x).

magic-g.title: 4. Max Win (5000x+)
magic-g.description: Target: 100,000+ coins. Strategy: H1_Aladdin (12+ cluster) for 1,000 coins + M500 multiplier. 1000 * 500 = 500,000, forcing the Max Win cap check.

olympus.title: 1. Base — small line win (3 units)
olympus.description: Single fixed line: three Diamonds (family high, 3 units). Pays the 3-unit payout, no modifier, no bonus. finished:true.

olympus.title: 2. Base — big line win (6 units, doubles)
olympus.description: Three DoubleDiamonds = 6 units = top line payout for that family. Modifier empty.

olympus.title: 3. Base — line win x10 multiplier
olympus.description: Three Sevens with the modifier reel = Multiplier x10. Line win is multiplied by 10. features.multiplier=10.

olympus.title: 4. Base — no win
olympus.description: Three different families on the line = no match = 0 win. Sanity check of a dead base spin.

olympus.title: 5. Trigger FG — 3 scatters, 0 golden coins
olympus.description: 3 Scatters on the line trigger the Free Game (triggerFreeSpin + choices:[1]); 0 super = 0 seeded golden coins. Tester auto-fires choice:1. FG: 2 steps land bronze/silver coins, then ends.

olympus.title: 6. Trigger FG — 1 golden coin (2 scatter + super)
olympus.description: 2 Scatters + super-scatter modifier trigger FG and seed 1 golden coin (value 50) at the first empty cell. FG lands a bronze then a gold on top of the seed.

olympus.title: 7. Trigger FG — 2 golden coins (super line + super modifier)
olympus.description: A SuperScatter on the line plus the super-scatter modifier = 2 seeded golden coins. FG lands a high coin on a fresh cell.

olympus.title: 8. FG — Multiplier modifier on a coin
olympus.description: Trigger FG (3 scatters), land coins, then the second step fires a Multiplier x10 modifier on a backend-chosen existing coin. Check features.modifier = { kind:'multiplier', target, before/after }.

olympus.title: 9. FG — Collector absorbs all coins
olympus.description: Trigger FG, fill the grid with coins, then the Collector modifier absorbs every coin into one target cell (total unchanged, other cells freed). Check features.modifier.kind='collector' + absorbed[].

olympus.title: 10. FG — Lives run out
olympus.description: Trigger FG, land one coin (resets lives to 3), then 3 empty steps land nothing so lives tick 3->0 and the bonus ends. Verifies features.livesAfter countdown + termination.

olympus.title: 11. FG — Max win cap
olympus.description: Trigger FG and flood the whole 5x4 grid with 500-value coins (=10,000 coins). At bet 20 the cap is 5,000 coins (x5000 total bet), so summary.hasMaxWin=true and the win is capped.
